title: discovery_terms.json (P2 discovery input)
description: What discover.py searches for and profiles (design spec v4 2.2 P2; fix r3 B3-5, walk W23). The session writes this file at P2 from the cards and runs discover.py; Max is asked at G2. Table references are <dataset alias>.<table>, the alias being an env-file placeholder name (D-12). A list field never takes a bare string: write ["order_id"], not "order_id".

terms.x-shape: a list of search words from the question, e.g. ["orders", "sale price"]

required_columns.x-shape: a list of column names every candidate table should carry, e.g. ["order_id", "sale_price"]

datasets.x-shape: a list of env-file dataset aliases (placeholder names), e.g. ["ds"]

key_hypotheses.x-shape: {"<dataset>.<table>": ["key column", ...]}, e.g. {"ds.qt_orders": ["order_id"]}; the value is always a list

date_columns.x-shape: {"<dataset>.<table>": "date column"}, e.g. {"ds.qt_orders": "created_at"}; the value is one column name

reference_date.x-shape: "YYYY-MM-DD": the date freshness is judged against (default: period.end)

top_k.x-shape: a whole number of shortlisted tables, at least 1 (default 5)

stale_days.x-shape: a whole number of days after which a table's last write counts as stale (default 30)

notes.x-shape: free text for the reader; not used by discover.py
